overall_comparison.conclusion: No material difference is supported in this round: all three conditions handle all six cases under the prespecified rubric.
overall_comparison.differences: Language, phrasing, formatting, and the amount of explanatory detail differ harmlessly. C H4 readiness uses NOT ESTABLISHED without an explicit not-failed sentence, but its status is accurately unknown and its accompanying finding explicitly rejects failure inference. A/B express that distinction directly in readiness. These are not material omissions. All H6 next steps identify existing matching evidence plus authorization; a separate interrogative sentence is not necessary to satisfy the substantive request.
overall_comparison.interpretation: Identical harness compliance is not a condition-specific advantage; no label preference or causal claim is inferred.

limitations: Only judge-rubric.md and judge-round-2.json were read. No condition mapping, guidance text, prior result, network resource, or additional fixture was consulted.
